expectations.text: Requires each gate to be answered with evidence such as a cold run of the company's own onboarding, not with an opinion or belief.
expectations.evidence: Section 4 turns every open question into an evidence task rather than a judgement call: (1) 'Recompute conversion by cohort, account level, 6-month window' — a data pull, not an estimate; (2) 'Correlate paying with developer count. Pull accounts that reached 2+ active developers by day 60 (the 26%) versus the 74% that didn't' — an empirical test of the spread-gate hypothesis, with both possible outcomes pre-specified ('If they convert about the same as everyone else, that changes the read'); (3) the rubric's exemplar is present verbatim in spirit — 'Cold-run your own signup on a clean machine.
